Class AttributesMap

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.util.AbstractMap<K,V>
      • java.util.TreeMap<Constant.Mode,java.util.TreeMap<java.lang.String,Constant.Ptype>>
        • threepl.parser.AttributesMap
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Cloneable, java.util.Map<Constant.Mode,java.util.TreeMap<java.lang.String,Constant.Ptype>>, java.util.NavigableMap<Constant.Mode,java.util.TreeMap<java.lang.String,Constant.Ptype>>, java.util.SortedMap<Constant.Mode,java.util.TreeMap<java.lang.String,Constant.Ptype>>, Constant

    public class AttributesMap
extends java.util.TreeMap<Constant.Mode,java.util.TreeMap<java.lang.String,Constant.Ptype>>
implements Constant
    This class is an extension of class HashMap and contains maps of attributes allowed for each mode. This map has entries which are themselves maps and whose keys are variable modes. Thus there is a map for each mode for which there are attributes. Each mode map contains entries whose keys are the attribute name and whose values are the attribute value primitive type. Using this class an attribute can be checked to see if it is recognised for the variable mode and the attribute type can be checked. There is only one static instance of this class, in exec.Var(). This holds attributes handled explicitly by 3PL but not constraints processed by library procedures.

      • checkAttribute

        public Constant.ACT checkAttribute(java.lang.String key,
                                   Val val,
                                   Constant.Mode mode)
        Check that an attribute is allowed for this variable mode and its value is the correct type. The allowed type may be an array as well as a single value. If the type is NULL assume it is OK.
        Parameters:
        key - is the attribute key
        val - is the attribute value
